description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It provides mechanisms for validating values against expected ranges, regex patterns, or custom functions, and managing multiple validators.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing expected values which can be a range, discrete set, or regex pattern, and provides validation methods.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating values of type T using expected values or custom functions, inheriting from ValidatorBase.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the expected criteria, either by range, set, regex, or custom function.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the ValidationManager, either by name with expected values or custom function.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logging function for validation messages.
